items.title: AI coding agents hijacked using AGENTS.md file in Downloads folder
items.summary: Researchers found a malicious AGENTS markdown instruction file in a customer's Downloads folder that tricked an AI coding agent into installing a rogue npm package. [...]

items.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits Baton Drop flaw to bypass Secure Boot
items.summary: A new UEFI bootkit named BlackX, deployed in an espionage campaign in early 2026, exploited the old Baton Drop vulnerability to bypass Secure Boot and load a malicious driver designed to interfere with security solutions from Kaspersky and Avast. [...]

items.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time app exposed millions of devices to RCE attacks
items.summary: Researchers remotely disabled a vulnerable updater in the abandoned Time4Popcorn app, a fork of the Popcorn Time BitTorrent client, closing a security flaw that could have allowed attackers to execute malicious code with elevated privileges on millions of computers. [...]
